title: Class-II gauge-horizontal source and relative-phase budget obstruction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A12 strict sharp cubes, the exact Class-II matrix has two independent phase-null directions and the next-shell source is an exact commutator. Nevertheless an explicit opposite-corner SU(2) relative-phase polynomial gives an asymptotic exact-B source-to-sextic ratio greater than 0.9, above gamma/3=0.54. Therefore the deterministic source-only absorption budget fails for every p>=1, and the exact determinant resolvent does not repair this carrier because its shell operator tends to zero.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTION-AND-EXECUTED-BUDGET-NOGO@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact Fourier products, the unit sharp regulator, and the A10-A12 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The Fierz, phase-null, commutator, carrier, and resolvent-limit statements are analytic. The finite degree-65536 polynomial is reproduced by coefficient-convolution and non-importing alias-free grid routes with a conservative margin; it is not labelled a formal floating-point interval proof.
falsifier: A failure of the compact Fierz matrix, separate doublet/singlet phase nulls, local phase covariance, output-shell commutator, active SU(2) carrier identity, fixed-floor independence, tensor octant formula, exact production covariance normalization, finite polynomial cross-route reproduction, conservative C_rel>0.9>gamma/3 comparison, resolvent O(N^-2) limit, source hashes, PDF QA, assertion count, or release gate falsifies this package.

reproduction.expected: Primary, non-importing independent, and integrated assertions pass; A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not prove that the exact source is unbounded, rule out a joint source-potential estimate or different true increment, prove the A11 stabilised log-Laplace theorem or A7 Nelson bound, construct an interacting measure, remove the floor or regulator, take infinite volume, prove a phase transition or BCC selection, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
next_action: Prove or refute A13-CLASSII-JOINT-SOURCE-POTENTIAL-LOG-LAPLACE by retaining the local sextic potential and exact noncentral determinant in one estimate, or redesign the true increment. Standalone deterministic source-square absorption and resolvent-only repair are forbidden by the relative-phase carrier.
notes: Scoped T4 exact structural reduction plus executed production-budget no-go. The compact Fierz form yields separate doublet and singlet local phase nulls, a sharp B<=beta_op*s bound, and the exact output-shell commutator. A degree-65536 opposite-corner SU(2) polynomial gives C_rel>0.9>gamma/3=0.54 by two independent finite routes. The determinant resolvent tends to identity on the carrier. T-049 is closed negatively; joint or redesigned routes remain open.
